evidence.title: KIO Data Centers will invest more than $400 million in CAPEX in the region and quadruple its capacity in Guatemala
evidence.excerpt: KIO's dated release announces the start of construction of its second Guatemala data center and reports a design total of 2 MW of IT load capacity.

metadata.retrieval_timestamp_basis: UTC whole-second mtime of the completed curl writeout, sampled after curl returned
metadata.publication_date_verification: The page data reports 2025-09-25T00:07:43 and the release text says September 25, 2025.

metadata.physical_status_scope: The lifecycle observation rests only on the dated first-party statement that construction started. No site-preparation, foundations, shell, MEP, commissioning, completion, or operating substage is inferred.
metadata.currentness_scope: The record preserves the last observed physical milestone as of 2025-09-25. Retrieval on 2026-07-21 proves only that the official page remained available; current July 2026 physical status is unknown.
metadata.identity_guardrail: The release calls this KIO's second Guatemala data center and places it next to GTM1, but does not itself name the new facility GTM2. The record therefore uses a source-scoped second-data-center identity and emits no unsupported GTM2 alias, street address, parcel, coordinates, building count, or phase split.
metadata.capacity_scope: The exact 2 MW total is expressly typed as IT load capacity and as design, so it is normalized once as design-stage critical IT capacity. The four 500 kW room figures are components of that total and are not added separately.
metadata.pue_scope: The reported 1.5 target is normalized once as design-stage PUE. It is not a measured or operating PUE.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The projected greater-than-80-percent renewable-energy share is future wording and creates no current power supply, generation, consumption, annual-energy, renewable-share, or measured-efficiency observation.
metadata.workload_guardrail: Cloud-computing and artificial-intelligence demand describe design intent only. They create no current workload, tenant, customer, user, occupancy, utilization, or operating-model observation.
metadata.role_guardrail: KIO announced the construction start and calls it its second data center, but this source does not expressly assign owner, operator, developer, landlord, tenant, customer, user, contractor, investor, or utility roles for the new facility. No normalized role is emitted.
